source: Spec 124 R-DA (McDonald's Airtight V3, 2026-10-17): migrated from the retired report-citation channel. Every entry is the measured PRE→POST diff of docs/reports/golden/refresh_snapshot/{pre,post} at 2a96590c, explained from the assessment report line it cites (L<n>), the runner code it names, or the captures' own measured values.

diffs.why: data_quality_snapshots row-count invariant 30 → 40: the table holds one row per snapshot date (report L468), and ten more dates were recorded between the PRE (30, report L386) and the 2026-10-16 POST. Night 1 recapture 2026-10-21 (REFREEZE-BUNDLE-1 split by R-II; public re-acquisition per operator CHAT-28; Spec 124 R-DA): INPUT DRIFT: the snapshot reads the night's reloaded tables (coa_applications 33949 -> 33975, lead_parcels 275431 -> 277039, CoA funnel and cost-coverage values), and invariant data_quality_snapshots_row_count 43 -> 44 is the snapshot row this night's run adds. NOT CODE: the night's runtime edits are runLinkPhase extra_counters (R-IG; this step declares none, so no key and no behaviour change, lock type-counters T6) and descriptor/notes/guard text that no runner reads at run time; they move lib_fingerprint (fef97e27 -> 93b059a9) and source_fingerprint, not this output. ENVIRONMENT: the first stdout line names the local dev DB's applied-migration count, now 268 (264/266 at the 2026-10-19/20 captures; migrations other lanes applied to the local DB since), and run-scoped log text (durations, pipeline_runs ids, before-image file timestamps) differs every run.
